approval_scope: Distinct local test principals exercise native SoD; not independent human authentication
balance_boundary_policy: Each entire agency/fiscal-year/period/ACTUALS population is one reconstructed activity Entry. Fund/class partitions may have nonzero net; their source fields and exact controls are retained. No amount is split, netted, rounded or added, and neither periods nor agencies offset each other. This explicitly selected boundary is not an original journal identity or a fund-balancing assertion.
department_scope: Exact nonblank DEPTID values; source blanks stay untagged, and departmental slices need not balance
dimension_export_scope: Exact native kind IDs and value VIDs, including explicit empty sets; source codes are checked separately against retained source and native registration, not inferred from a VID
dimension_scope: DEPTID, PROJECT_ID, PRODUCT and FUND_CODE map to native department, project, product and fund. Nonblank codes stay exact strings, whitespace-only is absent, and surrounding whitespace on a nonblank code is refused. Other chartfields, including CLASS_FLD and PROGRAM_CODE, remain in retained evidence without an invented native kind. An empty oracle key denotes source rows untagged for that dimension; it is never a native value. These annotations do not assert a balancing-dimension policy.
